name: Phone with four points
what: A column of phones scrolls down like a feed and settles on the middle one, which plays your video; a progress bar fills along its bottom edge, then four curly arrows draw out of its sides to four short points, two on each side.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f30 the column scrolls down and settles (slow start, long settle, cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.2, 1)); f44-f66 the progress bar fills (S-curve); f80-f90 four arrows draw out (expo out), heads f87-f91; f90-f106 the points rise in 2 f apart (10 f each); then a slow drift
